hypotheses.text: If Kofi Asante-Rhys (LB) had been 3 m closer, increased pressure would have reduced Theo Varga's shooting probability and likely prevented or made the finish much harder.

If Mateo Brann (CF) had been 3 m closer, his tighter marking could have cut down Theo Varga's shooting angle/time, lowering the chance of the goal and showing better central defensive positioning would have helped.
